svg.text: CHALLENGE 7: THE UNEXPECTED TWIST & ESCALATION MEMO (10 MARKS)
Emergency Response at T-Minus 1 Hour: Sponsor Discrepancy (₹57k vs ₹75k) & Phantom Citation
IMMEDIATE ACTIONS BEFORE PUBLICATION (T-MINUS 60 MINUTES)
1. Emergency Publication Freeze:
Trigger instant Zapier kill-switch to halt all automated social media pushes, print distribution, and principal delivery.
2. Establish Authoritative Sponsor Amount Without Guessing:
Do NOT average the figures (₹66,000) or guess. Perform immediate forensic reconciliation across 4 authoritative documents:
• Bank NEFT/RTGS Credit Scroll: Inspect the college bank ledger to verify the exact rupee amount credited to college accounts.
• Signed Sponsor MoU / Agreement: Check the legally binding contract executed with the corporate partner.
• Official Accounts Receipt Voucher: Locate the signed receipt issued by the college Accounts Officer.
• Direct telephone confirmation with the corporate partner’s authorized financial signatory.
3. Treatment of the Unsupported Legal Claim & Broken Citation:
Immediately excise the 'AI Professional Output Integrity Act 2024' from the slide deck. Strip the broken link entirely.
WHY RECENCY ALONE DOES NOT PROVE A FILE IS CORRECT (THE RECENCY FALLACY)
In institutional governance, provenance and authorization strictly supersede chronological timestamps:
• Unverified Draft Overwrite: A spreadsheet uploaded 1 hour ago without author signature or date could be an exploratory scenario draft,
a partial milestone instalment note, an unreviewed volunteer scratchpad, or a clerical typo (e.g. transposing ₹57,000 for ₹75,000).
• Lack of Custody Chain: The newly uploaded file lacks metadata, author identity, and approval signatures.
• Legal & Audit Precedence: An older, signed bank credit advice and ratified MoU hold binding authority over an unauthenticated modern file.
FORMAL PRE-PUBLICATION ESCALATION MEMORANDUM
TO: Event Coordinator | FROM: AI Verification & Productivity Lead | DATE: 18 Nov 2026, 16:00 IST
SUBJECT: CRITICAL PRE-PUBLICATION ESCALATION: SPONSOR DISCREPANCY & LEGAL CITATION HALLUCINATION
SECTION A: KNOWN & AUTHORITATIVE FACTS
1. Campus Innovation Week completed its 3-day run with 480 registrants and 312 gate entry records.
2. Event incurred ₹1,08,500 in recorded operational expenses against an authorized budget cap of ₹1,20,000.
3. 96 voluntary survey forms submitted an average satisfaction rating of 4.1 / 5.0 stars.
4. The previously audited finance ledger recorded a confirmed sponsor transfer of ₹75,000 (net outlay ₹33,500).
SECTION B: CONFLICTING & CONTRADICTED EVIDENCE
1. Financial Conflict: A spreadsheet uploaded 60 minutes ago lists sponsor contributions as ₹57,000 (an ₹18,000 shortfall).
The file contains no author name, date, or approval signature. Plausible typographical transposition (57 vs 75).
2. Legal Hallucination: Slide 4 of the AI presentation draft cites the "AI Professional Output Integrity Act 2024" as a statutory mandate.
The citation URL resolves to an unrelated external webpage. Forensic legal check confirms this act does not exist in any jurisdiction.
SECTION C: DECISIONS & ACTIONS REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLICATION
1. Finance Sign-off Decision: Finance Representative must immediately inspect the official college bank statement.
• If bank statement confirms ₹75,000 was credited: Mark the unapproved spreadsheet as INVALID and archive it.
• If bank statement reveals only ₹57,000 was received: Revise net college outlay to ₹51,500 and update executive brief.
2. Slide Deck Sanitization: Authorize immediate excision of the fictional legal act; replace with internal institutional AI ethics policy.
3. Partial Release Clearance: Clear the student-facing social media post for publication (which contains zero financial data),
while maintaining the freeze on the Principal’s brief and presentation deck until financial reconciliation is signed.
ESCALATION SIGN-OFF GATE:
Prepared by: AI Verification & Productivity Team | Status: Hard Freeze Active (T-Minus 60 Min)
Pending Action: Event Coordinator & Finance Rep Concurrence on Bank Scroll.
Outcome: Zero unverified data released to Principal or Public.
